Heal & Recharge

Practices for scalp health, stress relief and calm

"Do any one massage today for at least 5–10 minutes"
Increases blood flow to follicles · Reduces scalp tension · Log it when done ✓
"Inversion poses send blood to the scalp — 5 minutes a day makes a difference"
Hold each pose 30–60 seconds · Practice slowly · Never force a stretch
"10–15 minutes of meditation & breathwork daily can lower cortisol"
Cortisol is directly linked to alopecia flare-ups · Even 5 minutes counts
"Your worth extends far beyond your hair — confidence can be rebuilt"
Self-compassion lowers stress hormones too · Even 2 minutes helps
